title: Motorcycle Airbags Exist – But No One Uses Them?
summary: FortNine surveys motorcycle airbag technology and explains why airbags have not reached mainstream adoption. It breaks down gear such as the Helite Turtle, Dainese D-Air and Alpinestars Tech-Air.
why: Recommended in threads about airbag vests as a solid overview when shopping for a motorcycle airbag.

quote.text: If you're in the market for a Motorcycle Airbag, this is worth a watch.
